Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The petitioner is an accused in connection with T.R. Case No.36 of 2022, pending on the file of the learned Additional District & Sessions Judge-cum-Special Court under POCSO Act,
Nabarangpur, arising out of Umerkote P.S. Case No.181 of 2022, for alleged commission of offences under Sections 363/366/376(2)(n)/376(3)/109 of IPC read with Section 6 of POCSO Act.

3. Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s.439 Cr.P.C. by the learned Additional District & Sessions Judge-cum-Special Court under POCSO Act, Nabarangpur, by order dated 02.12.2022 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.
4. Notice is stated to have been served on the informant/victim on 21.01.2023 indicating that the matter shall be taken up today (22.03.2023).
There is no appearance on behalf of the informant/victim when the matter is called.

5. It is submitted by the learned counsel that the petitioner is in custody since 12.05.2022 and since charge-sheet has been filed on 10.07.2022, further continuance of the petitioner in custody is unwarranted.
6. Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer for bail.
